newsitem.title: USA: NY Fed declines to comment on Asahi report.
newsitem.headline: NY Fed declines to comment on Asahi report.

text.p: A Federal Reserve Bank of New York spokeswoman and a source at Asahi Bank's New York branch both declined to comment on a report the branch could face legal action for viewing a confidential Fed inspection report this summer.
"I can't comment on that," the Fed spokeswoman said. "We would never comment on any preliminary investigation that we may be doing," she said, adding that she was "not aware" of the report.
Japan's Kyodo News Agency reported from Tokyo that Asahi president Shigehiko Yoshino acknowledged that bank employees in New York had opened the Fed's sealed inspection report on Asahi.
Kyodo also reported that Yoshino said he realized the bank might face penalities for viewing the document.
"The act violates the Fed's internal rules and I suppose we will face some form of penalty," said Yoshino, according to Kyodo.
